title: OpenBao audit overview
description: OpenBao audit overview. Native SPL operator-question bindings. Read panel descriptions for windows, missing data, and required external sources. See the profile validation record for tested environments and native alert coverage.

options.query:
| `openbao_metric_samples("openbao_audit_archive_dead_letter_records_total")`
| search cluster=$cluster|s$ instance=$instance|s$ kubernetes_namespace=$kubernetes_namespace|s$ openbao_namespace=$openbao_namespace|s$
| where metric_name="openbao_audit_archive_dead_letter_records_total"
| search environment=$environment|s$ backend=$backend|s$ pipeline=$pipeline|s$
| `openbao_metric_rate15m`
| eval value=value*900
| `openbao_metric_fresh`
| stats latest(value) AS value BY _timeseries
| stats sum(value) AS value count AS contributing_series
| where contributing_series>0
| fields - contributing_series

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| where match(operation,"^(create|update|delete)$") AND match(request_path,"^sys/audit(/|$)")

| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| timechart span=5m count BY host limit=10 useother=t

| `openbao_metric_samples("vault_audit_log_re*")`
| search cluster=$cluster|s$ instance=$instance|s$ scrape_profile=$scrape_profile|s$ kubernetes_namespace=$kubernetes_namespace|s$ openbao_namespace=$openbao_namespace|s$
| where metric_name="vault_audit_log_request_sum" OR metric_name="vault_audit_log_request_count" OR metric_name="vault_audit_log_response_sum" OR metric_name="vault_audit_log_response_count"
| eval series=case(metric_name="vault_audit_log_request_sum","request",metric_name="vault_audit_log_request_count","request",metric_name="vault_audit_log_response_sum","response",metric_name="vault_audit_log_response_count","response") ." | ".coalesce(openbao_namespace,"(missing)") ." | ".cluster ." | ".scrape_profile
| `openbao_metric_rate5m`
| stats sum(eval(if(match(metric_name,"_sum$"),value,null()))) AS total sum(eval(if(match(metric_name,"_count$"),value,null()))) AS observations BY bucket_time cluster scrape_profile series
| where observations>0
| eval value=total/observations
| eval _time=bucket_time
| timechart span=15s max(value) BY series limit=20 useother=f cont=f

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| sort 100 - _time
| table _time host audit_type request_id logical_namespace request_path operation caller client_ip audit_error

`openbao_completed_events`
| search host=$host|s$
| stats count AS value

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| where match(operation,"^(create|update|delete)$") AND match(request_path,"^sys/(auth|audit|mounts|policies|raw|plugins|storage/raft|rotate)")
| sort 100 - _time
| table _time host audit_type request_id logical_namespace request_path operation caller client_ip audit_error

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| where match(mvjoin(audit_error," "),"(?is)(permission denied|forbidden)") AND (audit_type="response" OR (audit_type="request" AND match(mvjoin(audit_error," "),"(?i)^forbidden$")))
| stats count AS value

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| where match(operation,"^(create|update|delete)$") AND match(request_path,"^sys/(policies|auth|mounts)(/|$)")
| stats count AS value

viz_audit_archive_dead_letters.title: Archive dead letters
viz_audit_archive_dead_letters.description: Requires the separate audit-archive health exporter. These are exporter reports, not proof that an object-store copy is complete or immutable. Failure counters use 15-minute reset-corrected increases; missing telemetry is unknown. Last-success age is in seconds.

viz_audit_configuration_activity.title: Audit config changes
viz_audit_configuration_activity.description: Allowlisted audit metadata. Counts include separate request and response entries unless the query selects a type. Counts use the selected range; charts use disjoint five-minute buckets. Missing caller names do not imply anonymous access.

viz_audit_event_volume.title: Audit event volume
viz_audit_event_volume.description: Allowlisted audit metadata. Counts include separate request and response entries unless the query selects a type. Counts use the selected range; charts use disjoint five-minute buckets. Missing caller names do not imply anonymous access.

viz_audit_latency.title: Audit latency
viz_audit_latency.description: Rolling 5m calculation from upstream counters; resets are corrected per complete source series before aggregation. Means are weighted by observations; idle windows remain absent. Namespace and deployment identity are retained. Chart series are limited to 20; select one cluster and scrape profile for single-value panels.

viz_audit_request_failures.title: Request failures
viz_audit_request_failures.description: Reset-corrected request audit-delivery failures over a rolling five-minute window. An absent metric is unknown, not zero.

viz_audit_request_rate.title: Request audit rate
viz_audit_request_rate.description: Rolling 5m calculation from upstream counters; resets are corrected per complete source series before aggregation. Namespace and deployment identity are retained. Chart series are limited to 20; select one cluster and scrape profile for single-value panels.

viz_audit_request_response_balance.title: Request/response balance
viz_audit_request_response_balance.description: Request entries minus response entries in disjoint ten-minute buckets. Window edges, audit-device changes, and duplicate ingestion can create a difference; this is not an in-flight request gauge.

viz_audit_response_failures.title: Response failures
viz_audit_response_failures.description: Reset-corrected response audit-delivery failures over five minutes. Does not count application response errors.

viz_audit_response_rate.title: Response audit rate
viz_audit_response_rate.description: Rolling 5m calculation from upstream counters; resets are corrected per complete source series before aggregation. Namespace and deployment identity are retained. Chart series are limited to 20; select one cluster and scrape profile for single-value panels.

viz_audit_stream.title: Audit stream
viz_audit_stream.description: Allowlisted audit metadata. Counts include separate request and response entries unless the query selects a type. Counts use the selected range; charts use disjoint five-minute buckets. Missing caller names do not imply anonymous access.

viz_completed_request_logging.title: Completed request logs
viz_completed_request_logging.description: Completed-request log entries in the trailing 15 minutes to now, independent of the picker. Source logging is optional and disabled by default. A strict event-kind filter excludes ordinary operational logs. The macro exposes only timestamp, host, and event kind.

viz_high_risk_system_mutations.title: System mutations
viz_high_risk_system_mutations.description: Allowlisted audit metadata. Counts include separate request and response entries unless the query selects a type. Counts use the selected range; charts use disjoint five-minute buckets. Missing caller names do not imply anonymous access.

viz_permission_denied_responses.title: Permission denied
viz_permission_denied_responses.description: Audit entries whose visible error text matches permission denied or forbidden. HMAC-protected errors cannot be classified by this query. This is not an HTTP status count.

viz_privileged_configuration_mutations.title: Privileged config changes
viz_privileged_configuration_mutations.description: Allowlisted audit metadata. Counts include separate request and response entries unless the query selects a type. Counts use the selected range; charts use disjoint five-minute buckets. Missing caller names do not imply anonymous access.
